local_loss_method: Exact section polygons -> inward0.4mm/outward0.4mm morphological opening, round joins24; records local corner/rim loss even when whole-component erosion passes. Not extrusion path simulation.
limitations: Local corner/edge rounding loss is nonzero: use numerical rows, not a claim that all detail survives.
0.6mm outer rim rise is fused to shell; may soften in printing.
Crown plateau width1.2mm lowers theoretical circle apex by less than0.009mm for miniature robustness; not source detail.
Barrel ceilings/side openings require support or alternative print orientation.
No FFF toolpaths, printer or physical print tested.
